headline: CleanSpark Posts Fiscal Q4 and Full-Year 2026 Financial Results
summary: CleanSpark reported fiscal Q4 and full-year results, executing a $6.6 billion lease in Sandersville and securing 585 MW baseload status in Texas.
why: CleanSpark, Inc. is a US-based Bitcoin mining company that owns and operates data centers powered primarily by low-carbon energy sources.

impacts.name: CleanSpark
impacts.why: Quarterly financial results and infrastructure scale updates drive trading valuation in crypto-mining equities.
